note: v16.2.2 is the release to install. Every v16.2.x ships the SAME sost-node and sost-miner - byte-identical, same published hashes - so a node or miner already on any v16.2.x replaces only the CLI and never restarts. The update window is unchanged: node AND miner, after block #29,900 and before #30,000, and consensus is untouched since v16.1.0 (V16 activates at #30,000, first DTD Jackpot V2 #30,186). What .2 closes are the last two paths that still read the node's answer by scanning text: cancel-tx/bump-fee searched 'fee' from the start of the whole body, delimited each vin by the first '}' (so one nested object truncated the input list - and every dropped vin is a prev_value missing from the total that decides what a replacement returns to the wallet), and read fields with std::stoll on raw text, which aborts the process on a null or quoted value; capsule-decrypt counted payload_hex matches in order and guessed which output each belonged to. The CLI now has zero substring-scanned RPC answers, covered by 10 new assertions including the nested-object case.
